question.text: An investor withdraws Rs. 30 lakh from a PMS in year 2. Exit load is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI norms cap the exit load in the second year of a PMS investment at 2% of the amount being withdrawn. On a Rs. 30 lakh withdrawal, the exit load is 2% × Rs. 30 lakh = Rs. 60,000. The Trap: Year 1 carries a higher cap (3%) and year 3 a lower one (1%); no exit load is permitted after a period of three years from investment, i.e., from year 4 onwards. Picking 3%, 1% or zero confuses the second-year band with the surrounding tiers. Note: Document the full exit-load schedule (year 1, year 2, year 3 and post year 3) in the client disclosure document so that the basis of any exit-load deduction is clear at the time of withdrawal.
